verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at increase.com/llms.txt and a markdown documentation index at documentation.md that links to per-topic .md pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. A machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Missing for 10: first-party guidance describing how to use these docs with agents, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://increase.com/llms.txt # Increase
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://increase.com/documentation.md # Increase Documentation
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://increase.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
